top_signals.title: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh delivers his key Jackson Hole speech Friday. Here's what to expect
top_signals.summary: Prior Fed chairs have used the speech as an opportunity to lay out broad policy frameworks and intentions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: LNG WRAP: Asian LNG Above $23 as Qatar Extends Force Majeure
top_signals.summary: Asian spot liquefied natural gas advanced on sustained concerns about the Strait of Hormuz, with Qatar extending force majeure on deliveries of the fuel to European and Asian buyers by another month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: OneKey reproduces transaction replacement attack on outdated Ledger Ethereum app
top_signals.summary: OneKey said it reproduced an exploit against an older version of the Ledger app in its lab environment, which Ledger fixed in its Ethereum app 1.22.2, with no user funds lost.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Thieves Snatch $4 Million Necklace From Vienna Museum
top_signals.summary: A historic diamond necklace originally designed for the Egyptian royal family and valued at about $4 million was stolen from a major Vienna museum, triggering a police manhunt for the two alleged thieves.
